findings.title: First-run scenario literal contradicted by the render when a prior external pass exists
findings.recommendation: The MODIFIED iteration-note scenario keys first-run on 'no prior review-<mode>-<TS>.json' (internal emits only), but the report-rendering delta's shared axis counts 'internal emits and parsed external findings files alike' — reproduced in scratch: a trail with one external-proposal file and no internal emit renders 'Iteration: 2' + a trend, not the first-run literal. Two normative literals in the same change contradict; the implementation follows report-rendering (the ratified intent). This syncs to baseline as a demonstrably-false scenario. Align the orbit-review scenario pair to the shared axis: first-run WHEN = 'no prior same-mode review pass (internal emit OR external findings file)'; the subsequent-run WHEN correspondingly; the requirement prose 'prior run summaries exist' → 'prior same-mode passes exist'.

findings.title: Single-line grammar slots accept embedded newlines — record-sourced text can forge column-0 report grammar
findings.recommendation: Demonstrated: a finding title of 'Forged title\n## CRITICAL\n---' renders a column-0 heading and thematic break; stale_suppressed evidence can forge '### Findings'. The containment invariant is defeated through fields the grammar renders single-line (title, suppressed title/evidence, reviewer_class, depth). Extend normalizeInternalPass to fail loud on newlines in those fields (the strict-validation policy) — or collapse to one space as option bodies do; fail-loud fits the stated policy better.

findings.title: Task 5.1's claimed cross-source equivalence test does not exist
findings.recommendation: 5.1 is checked claiming a cross-source case proving an internal emit and an external file with equivalent findings render through one grammar — no such comparison test exists (the two shared-grammar tests assert external shape only). Criterion 1 is covered transitively (both genres byte-pinned to D2b goldens), so this is tasks-honesty. Add the small equivalence test (same findings both genres; assert equal section-heading sequences and identical tails) or amend 5.1 to what shipped.

findings.title: Retired [discuss] vocabulary in a worked-example heading, outside any retirement note
findings.recommendation: The heading '### (c) Decision-fork with [discuss] invoked' sits over a fully D4-updated example body (ratified_via: chat, no discuss_invoked) — the heading teaches the retired mechanism while its example demonstrates the replacement. Rename to '### (c) Decision-fork ratified by chat directive'; regenerate the surface; re-pin the parity hash if pinned.

stale_suppressed.evidence: Deliberate: the deleted machinery is the chat assessment branching — the spine field carries the deterministic counts sentence (template Step 9 + the delta scenario + the real emit agree); the renderer reads neither stored iteration nor iteration_note (tolerated extra fields), and trail artifacts are never edited.

stale_suppressed.evidence: Both self-consistent within their domains; D2b's letter (trimmed-title + line-stripped-path) honored; no real trail diverges; the gate model untouched by design.

commentary: The independent pass rendered every surface against the grammar's letter and audited the goldens against the spec rather than the implementation — both held, including byte-identity of the pre-boundary fixtures with the real archives. The four findings share a familiar shape: the CRITICAL is this change's own two normative literals disagreeing about what counts as a prior pass (the axis question, settled by the implementation's side); the forging WARNING is the containment invariant's letter outrunning its enumerated fields — the same genre as the option-body gap caught at proposal, one field family over. Verification coverage is otherwise the strongest of the program: 7/7 requirements mapped to tests, template greps clean outside one worked-example heading, and the regressions to D3 behavior byte-checked.
